question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "**faintly**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the given sentence, the nature of the image that we are able to see of the moon after the reflection.**
 
• Now, among the given options, the correct word to use is "faintly."
 
 
• "Faintly" means in a weak or unclear manner.(अस्पष्टतापूर्वक)
 
 
• Example: I faintly remember the memories of my childhood.
 
 
 
• The adverb "faintly" is the most appropriate choice to describe how moon is visible in the given context.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "lowly", means in a humble or meek manner.(नम्र)
 
• Option 3, "gloomily", means in a sad or depressed manner.(उदास)
 
• Option 4, "feebly", means in a weak or ineffective manner.(निर्बलता से)
